## Formal {.unnumbered}

$$
    H = - \sum_{i = 1}^S p_i \ln p_i
$${#eq-shannon}
$$
    H = \ln \frac{1}{\prod_{i = 1}^S p_i^{p_i}}
$${#eq-shannon-alt}

$$
    \lambda = \sum_{i = 1}^S p_i^2
$${#eq-simpson}

$$
    \frac{1}{\lambda} = \frac{1}{\sum_{i = 1}^S p_i^2}
$${#eq-simpson-inverse}

$$
    1 - \lambda = 1 - \sum_{i = 1}^S p_i^2
$${#eq-gini-simpson}
Probability of interspecific encounter (PIE).

$$
    \beta = \frac{\gamma}{\alpha}
$${#eq-beta-multiplicative}

$$
    \beta = \gamma - \alpha
$${#eq-beta-additive}

$$
    BC_{AB} = 1 - \frac{2 \sum_{i=1}^S min(N_i^A, N_i^B)}{\sum_{i=1}^S (N_i^A + N_i^B)}
$${#eq-bray-curtis}
$$
    J = \frac{c}{a + b + c}
$${#eq-jaccard}
$$
    J = \frac{2 c}{a + b + 2 c}
$${#eq-sorensen}

$$
    ^q D = \left( \sum_{i = 1}^S p_i^q \right)^{\frac{1}{1-q}}
$${#eq-hill}
